items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Rudy left me and I think he went with Billy Eckstine when Billy had his band.

ctx.x: with the first band I went to New York with. MR. FIELDS: Sure enough. MR. LOVE: Snub Mosley, 1943; earlier in the year. I joined Basie later that year. Leslie just died a year or two ago in Oklahoma City. MR. FIELDS: Yes, he sure did. I was fortunate enough--I don't call the funeral fortunate--but I was glad I was around to go. MR. LOVE: What did he die from? MR. FIELDS: Cancer. MR. LOVE: Did you know Rudy Morrison? MR. FIELDS: Yeah, sure, Rudy played with me also. MR. LOVE: I know. We worked together too. MR.…
Yeah a number of years, but it hasn't been too long for Leslie. He was a very fine guy and everything, and Les was a fine arranger too.
